data.text:
The Food Safety Designated Officer, ... vs M/S.Sri Balaji Sales
Corporation on 4 April, 2024
 The Hon'Ble The Chief Justice Alok Aradhe
 And 
 The Hon'Ble Shri Justice Anil Kumar Jukanti
 Writ Appeal No.774 Of 2015
Judgment: 
(Per the Hon'ble the Chief Justice Alok Aradhe) Mr. Mohammed Imran Khan, learned Additional
Advocate General for the appellant State. 
2. Learned Additional Advocate General, on instructions, submits t hat the issue involved in this writ appeal does not survive for consideration on account of efflux of time. 
3. In view of the aforesaid submission, the writ appeal is disposed of. There shall be no order as to costs. 
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, pending if any, stand closed. 
__________________ ALOK ARADHE, CJ ________________________ ANIL KUMAR JUKANTI, J 04.04.2024 Lrkm The Food Safety Designated Officer, ... vs M/S.Sri Balaji Sales Corporation on 4 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149156933/
